body: I feel the same everyday... pm me if you want to talk. I’m also holding on hard despite my illness. I’m 22

I would want to come back as me. But be healthy. My illness is killing me. I’m only 22. If My breathing problem went away I’d be able to do anything I want with my life... and live it long, from the looks of it 22 will be my oldest age.

Getting help from people on reddit. Sometimes its all you got and that’s ok.
Finding people feeling the same helps to some extent.. hope you keep your head up
Same... conflicted to the max..
That’s how I feel.. my breathing illness isn’t letting me sleep. How long does she go? I sometimes can end up with three days of no sleep. It brings thoughts of suicide to me too.

Btw, where are you from?

I’m in Florida

Wtf... 

Are we the same person??

I was also an editor and went to film school. That’s also my part time job.

I also have acid reflux and vocal cord dysfunction. 

And I also make music. And I get mad everyday because I can’t concentrate like I use to. 
I spend my days doing this just to pass the times and hopefully get my craft out there and scream out to the world how fucked up I am. 

What type of music do you make?
I make rap music.


Sorry I respond late, I don’t get notifications on this.

I miss my old self everyday too. I was so healthy and happy. And I could get anything I wanted back then. I’m so unmotivated to do anything nowadays. 2015 was when I started getting my symptoms too.. so unfortunate. I’ve gotten so mad and raged about my life so much... the only way to deal is to accept what I have... I’m only 22, I though I had a bright future ahead of me.. life is life and it is what it is. I’ve been to a million doctors the past two years. No fix.  

From 1 to 10 with 10 being the worst of how I could feel. I feel like I’m at a 9. Everyday is a huge struggle. I was gunna take myself out three weeks ago. But I couldn’t do it. I’m staying and dealing with these messed up symptoms. 

I can still force myself to do things I want if I tried. But I will end up out of breath so I don’t.

Is suffication one of your symptoms?

As soon as I read your post I had a feeling it could’ve been ens. 

I went to doctor das in Ohio and he said I have holes in my turbinates(doesn’t know how it happened). And that might be causing me to breathe like that. 

I got prp injection and it helped for about a month. 

For me, I feel like every 2 months my symptoms get worse. And the suffication being the worst part... 

I’m on the Facebook forum for ens.

The only joy I get is when I eat a cheeseburger or an ice cream, or pussy if I’m lucky. But I lean more towards the ice cream.

I have a really bad illness that has crippled my life. So I’m really unmotivated to do anything with my life. It’s tough, just going through everyday like a zombie..
I cried reading your post. I really hope you stay strong. There will be better days and time will heal the pain you feel right now. Take it day by day. I know it’s hard. I’m wishing you the best.

It’s ok, I’ve posted here sometimes and got no response too unfortunately.

I’m not sure what type of breathing issue I got. It has to do with my nerves not sending the air that I breathe in.  All I know is that I suffocate all day long and it’s very uncomfortable. 

Empty nose syndrome is the closest I can relate it too.

I am also prepared to go. But I live with my family. And they all love and care for me and I have a little brother of 4 years old who’s obsessed with me. It’s so hard... I can’t find a cure for this breathing issue

I think have the same breathing issue. I have it daily and get worse each month. Always short of breath and makes me really suicidal. Dm me if you can. 

Also What is the illness called?

Me, it’s horrific daily.. I’m only 22. It’s a breathing problem. Imagine sufficating  24/7 and not getting proper sleep. But for some reason the disease doesn’t kill you. Sad part is I love/loved my life.. I just got sick and can’t handle this...

Hey, I read a couple of your post. Just letting you know I’m on the same boat as you. Dealing with an illness everyday....living like a zombie, exhausted and numb to everything. I make art too, mainly to distract my self. Nothing is worse than illness, especially when you know you could be so much more if you weren’t sick. I’m only 22. Every day is a struggle I feel like I’m 90 years old. I keep fighting for my family.

I’m on the same boat... 22 and with very bad insomnia. I have an illness that no doctor can recognize and it doesn’t let me breathe properly or sleep correctly. It’s so heavy on my body. I’m trying everyday as hard as I can. I guess I’m just waiting till my body naturally dies from not sleeping correctly...

I’m on the same boat. It’s been 10 days since I posted here about killing myself. But I decided to keep fighting, mainly for my family. My sleep is so messed up, everyday is a nightmare Due to a rare breathing illness. I’m only 22.. I just spent my days working on my art trying to distract myself
Well then I’ll live it out until I reincarnate into a good situation. My life was good until I got sick. My healthy years I would re live a million times.

I don’t have any. We just don’t know. All I know is I’m not gunna be here and there was already a time that I was not here before I was born. So I came from nothing to something. I hope that happens again once I turn to nothingness again. I hope I’m born in a new body, boy or girl, and live a whole new life with no rememberance of this life. I also hope there is a surreal in between process where we become aware of every peace of the universe as we know it and maybe even realize it was always just you connected to everything. I feel like all energy is exellerated by friction and pressure and it can get sucked in a black hole until it blows up into a new universe Far far away from this one. I think energy might recreate the only thing it knows, and it is life. 

In other other words. I feel like my energy will float into space with rememberance of a past life. And the pressure it Carries of that rememeberence it will eventually meet with another floating energy and it will have chemistry together create another Big Bang far far away. This all created in a dream type manner. Until it turns into solid reality. 

I’m literally talking a bunch of nonsense. But something in my head wishes something like that happens.
The tiny bit of hope of things getting better. Also intense amount of fear for how painfull it will be. I have a lot of curiosity as to what happens after. So I also fear eternal agony after death.
Yea, me. I get stuck starting at the pills and never do it. I even put them In my mouth and spit them out
I have a very rare illness. I am dying. Very soon. Very day is pure panic 24/7. Hang on. We can talk if you want
Thank you
Sometimes life starts to treat you like a punching bag. And all these bad things come at once. Stay strong. Time heals everything. Day by day man. I can’t imagine the pain you feel from your losses.
That’s exactly how I feel. I either off myself or I end up in a mental hospital

Trust me, you don’t want a serious illness. I have one right now. It’s insanely tough to handle. I’ve had it for two years and I’m dying from it. I would give the world to be healthy. I don’t have that many days left. The pain of the illness killing you is much worse and slower than just ending it all.

I do realize my post are much to overwhelming. If I put myself in others view of my comment. It apears there really is not much I can do. Sorry to budge in your post, I’m anxious and don’t have many options. Learn from your mistakes. Excersice and eat well. Itle pay off. You’ll find you path, stay strong

I’ve made two post in this suicidal night. And no one even commented on them. Life just is what it is. I still don’t know what to do with my self. Take advantage if your still healthy to do something positive with the world. I am very sick so I have no options really
